notes.purpose: V1 fixed-gradient-budget resource allocation study on CIFAR10
notes.prior_access: The pilot200 have already had attack effects evaluated; full10000 target clean accuracy was checked in the pilot. new800 means not in initial attack-effect evaluation, not never queried.
notes.seed_mean: Mean success per image across BSR seeds; never best-of-seeds
notes.randomness: BSR geometry shared within each fixed batch. Seed is base+batch index; CUDA rotation backward may be nondeterministic.
notes.fixed_step_sensitivity: Every budget additionally uses MI alpha=epsilon/10; all comparisons predeclared and fully reported
